title: Siera
tagline: An explorer for the Superchain with ERC3770 chain-specific addresss and ERC7683 Transfers
description: We are a superchain explorer with ERC3770 and ERC7683 implementations. We create passkeys on the client. We also have feature to log in with facaster through privy. We show how to get all chains, and check for L2-L2 transfers though accross protocol. Our tests demonstrate transfer for ex. mode, base, optimisms etc.
